Schneaggchat is a passion project! Just the server and app store fees cost us about €125 a year (not counting development time). Your donation helps us cover that and build new features. Every contribution counts!
Thank you to everyone who has supported us!
The donation list is updated regularly. 100% of every donation goes straight into developing and running Schneaggchat.

Schneaggchat is a free, ad-free messenger for Android, iOS and Desktop – with a live map, events, polls, mini-games and the Vorarlberg dialect as a language option.
The messenger for you and your friends
Free · Open Source · No ads · Great support
We take the protection of your personal data very seriously. Here you can find out what data we process, why, and what rights you have.
If you have any questions about this privacy policy, you can contact us as follows:

The data controller within the meaning of the GDPR for the processing of your data in Schneaggchat is Florian Lerchenmüller (contact: schneaggchat@gmail.com). Schneaggchat is a private project with no commercial use of your data; appointing a data protection officer is not required under Art. 37 GDPR.
No data is processed for advertising or analytics purposes, and no data is sold.

Account data Username, email address (including verification status), password (stored only as a hash, never in plain text), profile description, status, date of birth, optional phone number, profile picture, as well as account creation and last-online time. Legal basis: performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). Retention period: until account deletion.
App settings Settings you choose, such as theme, language and map style, synced across your devices.
IP address Used briefly to prevent abuse (rate limiting), but not permanently stored in the database.

Messages and media Text, image and voice messages, polls, reactions and read receipts. Transmission is encrypted via TLS, but storage on the server is unencrypted. Legal basis: performance of a contract.

Location data Only if you enable location sharing for individual friends (opt-in); additionally, optionally speed, direction, altitude and battery level, if your device provides this. Legal basis: consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), revocable at any time. Location points are automatically deleted after 24 hours.

Schneaggmap entries Map points you create or edit, including their change history (including your username at the time of the change). Visible to all users. Legal basis: legitimate interest in a collaboratively maintained map (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

Groups and events Group membership, and for events: title, description, location, time period and invited users. Events marked as "public" are visible to all of the creator's friends, even without an invitation.
Games Scores achieved, including game mode and time. Leaderboards publicly display your username to other users.
Push notifications Device tokens for Firebase Cloud Messaging (Android) and Apple Push Notification Service (iOS), see the "Recipients" section below.

Log data Technical event logs (e.g. login, message sent, password reset requested) as well as the time and duration of connections to the server. Legal basis: legitimate interest in operation and error analysis (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
Login sessions Refresh tokens used to keep you signed in, valid for 30 days and automatically deleted afterwards.
Beyond this, no data is shared with third parties.
To operate Schneaggchat, we use the following external services (processors or independently responsible third parties):

Google Firebase Cloud Messaging and Apple Push Notification Service Receive your device token, the sender's username and message metadata in order to deliver push notifications. The actual message content is encrypted before transmission; the provider and your device manufacturer do not receive it in plain text.
Google Mail (Gmail SMTP) Used to send verification, password reset and account deletion emails, and for this purpose receives your email address and the email content.

Cloudflare (cdnjs) and Google Fonts When you visit this website, fonts and icons are loaded from these providers, which transmits your IP address to their servers (partly outside the EU, in particular the USA).
The data is stored on a server in 6850 Dornbirn, Austria. The external service providers mentioned above process data partly outside the EU/EEA.
You can delete your account yourself at any time via the app or via this page. For all other matters, please contact us at schneaggchat@gmail.com.
With regard to your personal data, you have in particular the following rights:
Right to access the data we process (Art. 15 GDPR)
Right to rectification of inaccurate data (Art. 16 GDPR)
Right to erasure of your data (Art. 17 GDPR) — e.g. by deleting your account
Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR)
Right to object to processing based on legitimate interest (Art. 21 GDPR)
Right to withdraw consent you have given (e.g. location sharing, wake feature) with effect for the future
Right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority, in Austria the Datenschutzbehörde (Art. 77 GDPR)
We are working on automatically removing or anonymizing this remaining data upon account deletion in the future as well.
When you delete your account, we immediately remove:
Your contributions to the Schneaggmap and their change history (remain visible under your username at the time)
Regular database backups, until they are overwritten in the normal cycle
For technical reasons, the following is currently not deleted:
Your user account, including login credentials and login sessions
All your friendships and group memberships
All messages you sent or received, including image and voice files
What happens when you delete your account
Despite these measures, no data transmission or storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
Among other things, we use the following technical protective measures:
Passwords are stored exclusively as hashes, never in plain text
Short-lived access tokens (15 minutes) with a separate, longer-lived refresh token

Schneaggchat is not specifically aimed at children. Users should have reached the minimum age required under applicable law to consent to data processing, or should obtain the consent of a parent or legal guardian.

We reserve the right to amend this privacy policy in the future. We will inform you of any changes by publishing the new privacy policy on this page. We recommend that you regularly check this privacy policy for changes. Changes to this privacy policy become effective once they are published on this page.
Reservation of the right to amend this privacy policy
Messages are not end-to-end encrypted — they are protected via TLS during transmission, but are stored unencrypted on the server.
Contributions to the Schneaggmap (map points and their change history) remain visible under your username at the time, even after you delete your account.
